selector.rationale: Evidence of pseudoepitheliomatous hyperplasia, parakeratosis, and dense dermal infiltrate of histiocytes, foamy histiocytes, neutrophils, and multinucleate giant cells along with pigmented hyphae, and fungal skin culture showing black yeastlike colonies characteristic of Exophiala spinifera species, which is consistent with Phaeohyphomycosis

rejected.label: Eumycetoma
rejected.why: Lack of granule formation in histopathology

rejected.label: Saddle nose deformity
rejected.why: It is a symptom, not a disease

rejected.label: Exophiala infection
rejected.why: While Exophiala spinifera is identified, Phaeohyphomycosis is a more specific diagnosis that encompasses the infection
